description: This file defines the CreateEntityDatatableChecksCommandHandler class, which handles the creation of data table checks in the Fineract infrastructure. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes commands of type ENTITY_DATATABLE_CHECK CREATE, and delegates the creation logic to the EntityDatatableChecksWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CreateEntityDatatableChecksCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles creation commands for entity data table checks by implementing the command handler interface and delegating logic to the service layer.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to create a data table check, executing within a transactional context.
